principles: Historical source observations are immutable and independent of current assumptions.
Commercial quantity scenarios do not apply an extra cleaning factor to already-reported commercial production.
Current national customs levels require an explicit historical source-scope bridge.

Missing/full-year-incomparable customs are kept as evidence; historical annual commercial flows may be carried only as a clearly labelled whole-year assumption, with no addition of partial observations.
All current conclusions remain conditional; no verified current production/stocks/sales or price forecast is invented.
